technical_hypothesis.interaction_pattern: human-approved repeated decision with bounded actions
technical_hypothesis.primary_training_data_risk: historical systems usually record only the chosen reminder, assignment or outreach action and final participation, without the eligible alternatives, assignment probability, consent state, fairness constraints or changing volunteer availability needed for reliable offline evaluation

training_data.observation_unit: one volunteer-engagement, appointment-recovery or mobilization decision at a defined decision point
training_data.input_data: confirmed candidate inputs include pre-decision availability, skills, location, consented channels, prior participation, workload limits, service urgency and eligible actions; completeness across OSCs is unknown
training_data.target_or_reward: confirmed participation, completed service access or filled role, penalized for excessive contacts, inequitable exposure, cancellations, safeguarding violations or coordinator rework
training_data.label_source: attendance, confirmation, cancellation, completed appointment, replacement and coordinator correction events; causal validity is unknown
training_data.prediction_time: after deterministic eligibility, consent, safeguarding, availability and workload checks and before an engagement action is selected
training_data.expected_volume: unknown and likely small or fragmented for many OSCs
training_data.class_balance: unknown; positive responses and urgent exceptions are expected to vary strongly by organization, cause, channel and season
training_data.historical_coverage: unknown; current volunteer platforms commonly preserve schedules, reminders, confirmations and hours, but not complete action propensities or counterfactual alternatives
training_data.train_validation_split: time-based and organization or campaign-grouped evaluation would be required, followed by prospective randomized or uniformly explored pilot arms where ethically acceptable
training_data.leakage_risks: using final attendance, later availability edits, coordinator substitutions, post-contact channel outcomes, beneficiary completion or emergency severity unavailable at decision time
training_data.representativeness_risks: cause, region, connectivity, volunteer profile, accessibility needs, emergency context, staffing and organizational maturity vary materially
training_data.feedback_loop: adaptive selection can repeatedly contact responsive volunteers, suppress exploration for less represented groups and reinforce historical geographic or digital-access disparities
training_data.privacy_and_usage_constraints: contact, location, participation and beneficiary-service data require minimization, purpose limitation, consent and LGPD controls; sensitive traits must not be inferred for targeting
training_data.fallback_if_data_is_insufficient: use structured availability and consent, deterministic eligibility and safeguarding rules, fair rotation, workload caps, ordinary reminders, waitlists, manual escalation and explicit prospective instrumentation before any adaptive policy

portfolio_comparison.reason: The simulated adaptive decisions are plausible, but volunteer scheduling, reminders, confirmations, hours and basic matching are already covered by current platforms and deterministic controls. The remaining bandit hypothesis lacks trustworthy propensity and counterfactual data and would be an internal experiment after prospective instrumentation, not a differentiated repository opportunity. Donor outreach is already represented by NONPROFIT-001.

existing_landscape.summary: Adopt volunteer-management, scheduling, reminder and reporting platforms; add explicit consent, eligibility, fair rotation and workload controls. Instrument eligible actions and assignment probabilities prospectively only when a bounded adaptive experiment is justified.

research.findings: Current Brazilian evidence confirms substantial volunteer activity and increasing formal management. Current platforms already provide opportunity publication, availability, scheduling, notifications, attendance, hours and reporting. Recent research shows contextual bandits can support charitable outreach and food-rescue volunteer engagement, but also highlights exploration, fairness, budget and policy-learning trade-offs. The repository-valid conclusion is insufficient-data-path and adoption rather than a new opportunity.

where_ai_enters.primary_mechanism: select one action from a pre-approved eligible set for a repeated volunteer-engagement or service-recovery decision, only after prospective instrumentation
where_ai_enters.human_control: coordinators retain eligibility, safeguarding, consent, workload, geographic equity, escalation, beneficiary priority and final assignment authority
